summary: Module 4: AtmosphericInversionLoss — a physics-informed PyTorch loss function combining MSE+MAE prediction error with a Conservation of Mass Penalty Term. The penalty fires when wind velocity is stagnant (<2 m/s) AND PBL height is compressed (<400m) BUT PM2.5 is predicted to decrease without a transport mechanism, violating mass conservation. Also includes an inversion severity regulariser that penalises underestimation of PM2.5 during PBL trap events.
